critique.author: featherless / Qwen/Qwen3-32B
bullets: Adjust the lunch window gate: Shorten or shift the 11:30-13:30 restriction to capture late-afternoon opportunities (e.g., 12:00-13:00), as 40 rejections cite this rule during a period when 14:00+ momentum ideas were still being generated.

Lower confirmation threshold from 3/6 to 2/6 for intraday_momentum: 3/6 confirmations were insufficient for risk approval in 3 of 8 declined ideas (e.g., QQQ at 14:00:33), yet 4/6 confirmations still failed due to sizing rules.

Increase max risk per trade from 1.0% to 1.5% of equity: The QQQ idea (max loss $293.5) was risk-approved but unsent due to critic scoring, while TLT ideas (max loss ~$1,450) were rejected outright despite 4/6 confirmations.
Expand liquidity filter for SPY/DIA/TLT: 9+ rejections cite "no contracts survived," but these are high-volume symbols. Test relaxing open interest/volume thresholds by 20% for these tickers.

Validate critic scoring logic: The 14:30:12 TLT idea shows a critic score of 0.55 passing a 0.55 threshold, which is mathematically impossible. Audit the critic's scoring function for off-by-one errors.

Collect IV rank data for all symbols: 12 rejections cite "no IV rank available," but the system only tracks it conditionally. Enable IV rank logging for DIA/EEM/GLD to validate its absence as a legitimate veto.
